# Rule 7 — Self-antagging, griefing, and round disruption
Do not intentionally ruin the round for other players without a valid in-character reason or antagonist role.
Self-antagging means acting like an antagonist when you are not one. This includes random murder, sabotage, theft of critical equipment, starting major disasters, releasing dangerous entities, or causing mass chaos without proper roleplay justification.
Griefing is not allowed. Do not destroy important areas, spam explosives, vent the station, sabotage power, block evac, steal emergency supplies, or otherwise disrupt the round just to be annoying.
Non-antagonists may still commit crimes or create conflict, but it must be believable, proportional, and roleplayed. Your actions should create interaction, not simply remove other people’s ability to play.
